scope.externalVisibility: deferred by operator; no publisher, directory, prospect or outreach research performed

methodology.gsc: Google Search Console API through existing local GoogleAuth ADC with webmasters.readonly. Page totals were exported separately from page+query, page+country and page+device rows. Trailing-slash and non-trailing-slash URL variants were normalised and summed.
methodology.privacy: Omit identifier patterns, very long free text, and personal clinical narratives. Omitted query text is never persisted.
methodology.html: Current public HTML was fetched for the nine pages and seven support routes. Title, meta description, H1, robots, canonical, JSON-LD types and internal anchors were parsed from rendered response HTML.
methodology.intent: Visible queries were classified as service-relevant commercial, service-relevant explanatory, brand or irrelevant from query text. Landing pathname alone was not used to infer brand.

externalSearchIntentChecks.finding: Sampled results are strongly transactional service pages organised around certificate type, request flow, price and clinical review. This supports the existing commercial/explainer page split; no competitor claim was adopted.

externalSearchIntentChecks.queryFamily: repeat prescription online Australia / how online prescriptions work
externalSearchIntentChecks.finding: Results mix repeat-service pages with official eScript explainers. This supports /prescriptions as the commercial owner and /online-prescriptions as the explanatory owner.

externalSearchIntentChecks.queryFamily: erectile dysfunction assessment or treatment online Australia
externalSearchIntentChecks.finding: Results mix clinical explanation with commercial assessment/treatment entry pages. The intent bridge is real, but InstantMed must retain assessment, underlying-condition and no-guarantee boundaries.

externalSearchIntentChecks.queryFamily: online hair loss treatment Australia doctor
externalSearchIntentChecks.finding: Commercial results commonly use treatment language while describing doctor assessment. This corroborates the GSC vocabulary gap but does not justify a change during the held experiment.

externalSearchIntentChecks.queryFamily: UTI assessment online / contraceptive pill assessment online Australia
externalSearchIntentChecks.finding: Sampled results show narrow pathway pages rather than a single broad women's-health answer. InstantMed's pill child page surfaced for the exact pill query; the UTI sample surfaced another narrow assessment provider. No rank or search-volume claim is made.

linkInventory.conclusion: No useful missing internal link was found for this batch. Certificate and prescription pairs cross-link, the women's hub links both child pages and repeat prescriptions, each child links back to the hub, and the pill page links the unchanged-repeat route. Repeating global links inside every section would add noise without solving an observed gap.

aggregateFindings: The normalised /medical-certificate total is 7,654 impressions, two more than the canonical-only baseline because the page export also found and summed a two-impression trailing-slash row.

The women's hub average-position improvement is not a service-intent win: nearly all current visible query impressions are an irrelevant Turkish term, while most page-level impressions are not exposed in query dimensions.
ED and hair visibility grew around treatment-seeking commercial wording, but both landing experiments are held and compliant assessment framing remains the correct promise.
The prescription pair and UTI child have no measurable page/query visibility; crawl/index rechecks precede copy expansion.
Only the UTI and pill child first-screen process wording is eligible now; no metadata, H1, safety, CTA routing or link expansion is supported by the evidence.
limitations: Search Console suppresses/anonymises query and dimension rows. Page totals are authoritative for page performance and are intentionally kept separate from query, country and device rows, which may not sum to them.
Low-volume query samples cannot establish stable intent ownership or conversion impact. Null percent deltas mean the prior value was zero.
Average position is an impression-weighted aggregate, not a fixed rank. Positive deltas in average-position numeric value mean worse position.
URL Inspection status comes from the separate 2026-09-05 baseline receipt and is not a Live Test rendered proof.
Current public HTML was fetched before the separately owned crawl/schema release and before the parent child-page wording change; post-release verification belongs to the coordinating task.
Search-result sampling establishes result type and vocabulary only. It is not search volume, rank tracking, market-share or competitor-claim substantiation.
General antibiotics articles were excluded as growth targets. No external publisher, directory, prospect, backlink or outreach work was performed.
